name: Sdb-006
summary: SDB-006 is a drug that acts as a potent agonist for the cannabinoid receptors, with an EC50 of 19 nM for human CB2 receptors, and 134 nM for human CB1 receptors. It was discovered during research into the related compound SDB-001 which had been sold illicitly as "2NE1". SDB-006 metabolism has been described in literature.

pharmacology.text: SDB-006 is a drug that acts as a potent agonist for the cannabinoid receptors, with an EC50 of 19 nM for human CB2 receptors, and 134 nM for human CB1 receptors.

uses.text: It was discovered during research into the related compound SDB-001 which had been sold illicitly as "2NE1".

summaryZh: SDB-006是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C21H24N2O，帶有吲哚-3-甲醯胺結構，與其同系物SGT-56都為人工合成的大麻素。
summaryZhHans: SDB-006是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C21H24N2O，带有吲哚-3-甲酰胺结构，与其同系物SGT-56都为人工合成的大麻素。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Synthetic cannabinoids as a group can cause anxiety, paranoia, a racing heart, vomiting, confusion and psychosis, and have been linked to seizures, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths. Regular use can lead to dependence and difficult withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。合成大麻素整體而言可能引起焦慮、偏執、心跳過快、嘔吐、意識混亂和精神病症狀，也曾與癲癇發作、腎損傷、心臟病發作和死亡有關。規律使用可能導致依賴和難熬的戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。合成大麻素整体而言可能引起焦虑、偏执、心跳过快、呕吐、意识混乱和精神病症状，也曾与癫痫发作、肾损伤、心脏病发作和死亡有关。规律使用可能导致依赖和难熬的戒断症状。

fact.en: SDB-006 prefers the CB2 receptor, which sits mostly on immune cells rather than in the brain, unlike most synthetic cannabinoids sold as drugs.
fact.zh: SDB-006 偏好 CB2 受體，這種受體主要位於免疫細胞上而非大腦中，和多數被當作毒品販售的合成大麻素不同。
fact.zhHans: SDB-006 偏好 CB2 受体，这种受体主要位于免疫细胞上而非大脑中，和多数被当作毒品贩售的合成大麻素不同。
